title: The Bear and the Pear
lines: A brown bear sat under a pear tree.
It was the best pear tree in the woods.
The bear could see the pears up in the air.
But all the best ones were at the top.
He stood up tall on his back paws.
He could not reach them at all.
So he went to his den to get a chair.
The chair was old and had a tear in it.
He set it under the tree and stood on it.
The chair fell down with a bang.
The bear fell too, and sat on the grass.
Now the chair had three legs, not four.
He made a face at that old chair.
Then he had a plan. He got up.
He got both paws on the tree and hugged it.
He shook that tree as hard as he could.
Ten pears came down all at once.
One of them landed on his head.
The bear ate three and saved the rest.
A small bird came by to share them.
They sat and ate pears in the sun.

questions.ask: Why did the bear get a chair?
questions.listenFor: To get up to the pears, which were up in the air at the top of the tree.

questions.ask: How did the bear get the pears down in the end?
questions.listenFor: He hugged the tree and shook it hard. Point out that pear, bear and tear all rhyme.

questions.ask: Do you think the bear will try the chair again? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason, not the right answer.
